description: This Java source file contains the implementation of an immutable class DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl, which extends an abstract class and implements an interface for a command that deletes feature properties in a live signal command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create instances, retrieve feature ID, category, and set headers.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand, providing methods to create instances, access feature ID, get category, and modify headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to DeleteFeatureProperties.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates that this command does not change authorization.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for the answer to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this object.
